_comment: What every creature's mind shares. A creature's own nature comes from its seed; these are the numbers they all have in common. Editing this while the game runs applies at once. See Game/Creature/CreatureTuning.h for what each means.

director._comment: Pacing. Pressure builds while creatures are close to or busy with the players and drains when nothing is near; at full pressure the ones near are asked to give the players room. After a quiet spell, an idle creature is nudged to somewhere near a player.

quirks._comment: Habits of their own, drawn from each creature's seed: how many each has, and how likely each habit is (0 for never). See Docs/AI.md, Every one different.
